title: Fast Uncertainty Quantification for Kernel-Based Estimators in Large-Scale Causal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2603.13662v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Kernel methods are widely used in causal inference for tasks such as treatment effect estimation, policy evaluation, and policy learning. The bootstrap is a standard tool for uncertainty quantification because of its broad applicability. As increasingly large datasets become available, such as the 2023 U.S. Natality data from the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS), which includes 3,605,081 registered births (of which 2,980,739 form our analytic sample after cohort restrictions), the computational demands of these methods increase substantially. Kernel methods are known to scale poorly with sample size, and this limitation is further exacerbated by the repeated re-fitting required by the bootstrap. As a result, bootstrap-based inference for kernel-based estimators can become computationally infeasible in large-scale settings. In this paper, we address these challenges by extending the causal Bag of Little Bootstraps (cBLB)

translated_title: 大规模因果推断中基于核方法的估计量的快速不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 核方法在因果推断中被广泛应用于处理效应估计、策略评估和策略学习等任务。自助法凭借其广泛的适用性，成为不确定性量化的标准工具。随着越来越大规模的数据集变得可用，例如来自美国国家生命统计系统（NVSS）的2023年美国出生数据，其中包含3,605,081例登记出生（经过队列筛选后，其中2,980,739例构成我们的分析样本），这些方法的计算需求大幅增加。众所周知，核方法随样本量增大时的扩展性较差，而自助法所需的重复重新拟合进一步加剧了这一局限。因此，在大规模场景下，基于自助法的核估计量推断在计算上可能变得不可行。在本文中，我们通过扩展因果小自助法（cBLB）来应对这些挑战……
tldr: 本文通过扩展因果小自助法（cBLB），实现了大规模因果推断中基于核方法的估计量的快速不确定性量化，解决了传统自助法在数百万级样本数据集上计算不可行的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the causal Bag of Little Bootstraps (cBLB) to enable fast uncertainty quantification for kernel-based estimators in large-scale causal inference, addressing the computational infeasibility of conventional bootstrap-based inference on massive datasets.
